name: SMR official-feature/MLP adaptation, first filter
training_queries: Nordland train 1-600 only, full 1750 reference gallery
features: official four ratios, topN=1, epsilon=1e-6, group window=2
ground_truth: existing +/-5 ordinal frames for training labels only
fit: unchanged official mlp_train, SMOTE random_state42 and source-default MLP/5fold CV; CV is diagnostic, no test tuning
inference: trust all predicted classes as original 100% operating point, fixed confidence cutoff 0; abstain for class 1 or 3
closed_set_recall: all common queries remain denominator; abstentions count as misses; never delete rejected queries
startup: fall back to A until nine frames; reset each split/traversal
changes_from_paper: one encoder training rather than seven
our existing low-resolution encoders and split
full gallery rather than square geographically cropped training gallery
Nordland-only transfer rather than refitting on independent dataset
confidence cutoff0 avoids noncausal whole-test confidence order statistic
not_claimed: official benchmark result or full end-to-end published reproduction; match restoration not implemented
